task.ques: Determine the price difference between the latest series of Apple Watch and Apple Watch SE on the Apple website.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: The latest Apple Watch Series 12 starts at $399, while Apple Watch SE 3 starts at $249—a $150 USD difference, with Series 12 costing more. These are Apple’s U.S. starting prices as viewed on October 27, 2026.
Source: https://www.apple.com/watch/ — “Explore the lineup.” Evidence: final.png shows both model names and starting prices together.
